title: Agricultural Extension Education
modules: Philosophy, Objectives And Principles Of Agricultural
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process identifying or defining problems, formulation goals, thinking of ways to accomplish goals, and measuring progress towards goal achievements (Middleton and Hsu Lin, 1975)."
Planning is a process identifying or defining problems, formulation goals, thinking of ways to accomplish goals, and measuring progress towards goal achievements (Middleton and Hsu Lin, 1975).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a final key feature that will make the system adaptable to different socio-cultural or geo-ecological environment."
Flexibility is a final key feature that will make the system adaptable to different socio-cultural or geo-ecological environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those established and funded by government in USA."
Land Grant Universities are those established and funded by government in USA.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an effective visual aid when used properly."
The chalkboard is an effective visual aid when used properly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential development tool that places information sharing as an additional 'factor of production'."
Agricultural extension is an essential development tool that places information sharing as an additional 'factor of production'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the gap between what is and what ought to be."
Need can be defined as the gap between what is and what ought to be.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document consisting of a combination of planned activities prepared jointly by the people and extension worker with the advice of relevant specialists."
The extension programme is a document consisting of a combination of planned activities prepared jointly by the people and extension worker with the advice of relevant specialists.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool that ensures extension programmes are successful and sustainable."
The extension process essentially is a tool that ensures extension programmes are successful and sustainable.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a professional communication intervention deployed by an institution to induce change in voluntary behaviours with a presumed public or collective utility (Röling, 1988)."
Extension is a professional communication intervention deployed by an institution to induce change in voluntary behaviours with a presumed public or collective utility (Röling, 1988).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to reinforce or clarify a speaker's message."
Presentation visuals are used to reinforce or clarify a speaker's message.
fib: ______ is the most important method for advising and promoting the interest of a large number of small farmers.
